title: Volume Bounds for Holes in Very Ample Semigroups
statement: Suppose a set of lattice points, not necessarily all lattice points of its convex hull, gives a very ample embedding, and let $P$ be the resulting lattice polytope. Can the height of the highest hole in the associated semigroup be bounded in terms of the normalized volume of $P$?

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The highest-hole height question is not settled by the general volume bounds for lattice polytopes; the extracted report leaves this semigroup bound as an open problem.
